SEARCH
Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.properties

Class DcatResource

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.properties.DcatResource
Direct Known Subclasses:
DcatDataService, DcatDataset
public class DcatResource extends Object
DcatResource holds the properties that are common to the resources described in a DCAT catalog (dcat:Resource): datasets, dataset series, data services and the catalogs themselves.
